description_for_human: An OpenAI-compatible gateway to Pollinations. Bring your own Pollinations API key.
description_for_model: Gateway that proxies OpenAI-compatible requests to Pollinations. BYOP: every request must include the caller's own Pollinations key as 'Authorization: Bearer sk_...'. Without a key the API returns 401. Base URL for OpenAI-style paths is https://aibridge.bot.nu/v1. Full schema at https://aibridge.bot.nu/openapi.json, plain-text contract at https://aibridge.bot.nu/llms.txt.
